results.spec: invariant jobs.finishedAt update only not exists walls[job = .id, stage = 'removal']
invariant rescans.insert only not .scan.visit.herd.restricted or exists approvals[visit = .scan.visit]
invariant treks.status update only not .crossesPrivateLand or .routeApproved or .status = 'booked'
invariant moves always .photoTable != null and .photoSlate != null and .photoStair != null
invariant jobs.status update only not .customerSignedFailing or .customerConsent or .status != 'crack_filling'
invariant jobs always .status = 'quoted' or exists photos[job = .id]
invariant castings always .stage = 'molding' or .stage = 'cancelled' or .modelApprovedAt != null
invariant bookings.contract read only .couple = viewer or exists roles[principal = viewer, role = 'owner'] or exists roles[principal = viewer, role = 'desk']
